thread:
alerts-bot: 🚨 multiple customers reporting p95/p99 regressions and long queue wait times on the gpt-small-v2-quant pool. sample request_ids: req_3f2a, req_91b4, req_782c. p99 token latency ~+3s over baseline. ingress admission rejects spiked. tagging eng-oncall + eng-runtime.

marta: ack — thanks. which customers? can you paste a quick repro curl and any short logs? i'll start the customer comms. @samir @josh can you take a look? :eyes:

samir: on it. please include request_id and model name — got the ones above. any recent deploys to that pool?

marta: no deploys from product team in past 24h, customers A/B/C hit this between 07:12-07:14 UTC. repro curl below (sanitized):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Model: gpt-small-v2-quant" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":256}' \
  -w '\n%{time_total}s\n' -sS -o /dev/null
```

marta: customers observing long queue wait before token generation — not slow decoding once admitted.

samir: digging into ingress. quick snapshot from ingress logs:

```text
[07:12:05] ingress-1 worker=worker-23 req=req_3f2a queue_wait_ms=3120 admit=false reason=concurrency_limit
[07:12:06] ingress-2 worker=worker-24 req=req_91b4 queue_wait_ms=2890 admit=false reason=concurrency_limit
[07:12:08] ingress-1 worker=worker-23 req=req_782c queue_wait_ms=3345 admit=false reason=concurrency_limit
```

samir: looks like admission.rejections spiked concurrently with queue_wait. pool-id=pool-qs-7 using concurrency_limit=8. CPU on worker-23/24 at ~92% when admitted; but many requests queued before hitting limit.

josh: I see the pool config — quantized kernels increase CPU per inference vs fp16; the batcher sizing may be tuned for fp16 earlier. possible regression if traffic mix changed. for immediate mitigation: (1) bump concurrency for pool-qs-7 from 8 -> 12, (2) enable fallback routing to gpt-small-v2-fp16 for new requests, (3) enable prefix KV cache more aggressively for repeated prompts. I'll also hotpatch admission policy to allow short bursts for warmup traffic.

samir: applying hotfix: set pool-qs-7.concurrency=12 and enable fallback to fp16 variant. enabling a 30s burst window now. will watch metrics.

marta: i'll notify impacted customers that we're applying mitigations and monitoring — ETA for visible improvement?

samir: hotfix pushed at 07:16 UTC. initial telemetry: p95 dropped from ~1.1s -> 220ms, p99 down from ~3.2s -> ~1.0s within 80s. queue_wait histogram showing tail reduction. still observing a handful of rejects from a small tenant with very large parallelism.

josh: next steps (post-hotfix): create runtime ticket to audit batcher sizing for quantized kernels, add a canary test simulating mixed fp16/quant traffic, and add per-tenant fairness knob in admission controller. also add a quick runbook entry: when pool p99 queue_wait > 1s, temporary bump concurrency and flip fallback to fp16.

marta: thanks — i'll update customers and close the escalation once stable. please paste the runbook link or ticket id here when created. :thumbsup:

samir: will follow up with logs and short RCA tomorrow once we have full traces. marking this thread resolved for now, reopen if tail returns.

josh: created ticket RUNTIME-1429 "audit batcher sizing for quantized kernels and add admission fairness" and added runbook PR.

marta: 👍 closing customer-facing loop now. thanks everyone!
